loss: canonical C5 state loss, global sum over 24 GDN layers divided by 24
teacher: canonical full-model unrotated no-grad continuous cache; detached target
student: canonical key-side Hadamard-initialized Cayley, INT8-C128 STE QDQ, differentiable recurrent writeback
load_placement: Full canonical Qwen model is loaded with device_map=None and moved to the sole CUDA device before freezing, matching the previously validated single-GPU teacher reference; C5 patch/loss/optimizer source is unchanged.
detach_interval_tokens: H for each respective horizon, including recurrent, convolution, key/value caches
sustained_memory_measurement: After each update, release the rollout/cache/capture graph, collect Python garbage, empty the CUDA cache, and compare five end-of-update allocated baselines. A span above 256 MiB stops the diagnostic before the rotation-checkpoint extension.
checkpoint_rule: Only if first five sustained updates pass; continue same diagnostic process to eight total updates and save rotation parameters only.
